cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:4a5b34c3-b561-40.title: Sr. Specialist, Risk Management Litigation
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:4a5b34c3-b561-40.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: An integral member of the Risk Management team supporting the Operations team in managing real estate assets. This position will be primarily focused on general liability claims and RMIS system management (60%) but will involve general risk management support such as generating COI’s, working with lenders, obtaining quotes for new assets, processing of invoices, reviewing contract language and other duties as necessary to support departmental needs (40%).
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in business, Insurance and Risk Management, or a related field (equivalent experience may be considered).

Minimum of 7 years of experience in claims heavy organization (4 years litigated claims experience) or claims supervisor at TPA, insurance carrier or broker, with a focus on commercial real estate organizations or construction, general liability litigation, and property.
Strong knowledge of claims handling processes, insurance industry regulations, and best practices.
Experience in managing claims systems (preferably Riskonnect) and processes.
Proficiency in using RIMIS software and related tools.
Experience working with TPA's is highly desirable.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., AIC, CPCU) are a plus.
Demonstrated excellent customer service skills and a passion to help others.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Proven experience with advanced Excel functions and data management.
Ability to work independently.
Exceptional organizational skills and a proactive mindset.

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:b0.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THIS JOB Replit is redefining how software is built, and who gets to build it. Our mission is to achieve Autonomy for All: making programming accessible, collaborative, and powered by AI. To realize this vision, we are building a brand that is as iconic, inventive, and human as the product itself. We are seeking a Brand Copy Lead to shape how Replit is expressed across the world. You will be responsible for crafting the voice of our brand, writing breakthrough copy across campaigns, marketing assets, and product surfaces, and ensuring Replit’s story shows up with clarity, consistency, and cultural impact. You’ll move fluidly from high-level concepting to meticulous execution, working closely with design, marketing, product, and external partners to bring the Replit narrative to life. This is a role for a Copy Lead who thrives at the intersection of storytelling and strategy. Someone who can define timeless brand foundations while also creating standout expressions that inspire, resonate, and endure. This role reports directly to the Executive Creative Director, ensuring close collaboration on vision, craft, and execution. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Define and evolve Replit’s brand voice, tone, and narrative across all communications. - Lead copywriting for high-profile product launches, campaigns, events, and cultural activations. - Write and adapt marketing assets across channels — web, social, email, paid media, video scripts, event copy, and more. - Create scalable editorial guidelines and frameworks that empower teams across the company to write with excellence. - Collaborate with designers, marketers, strategists, and agency partners. - Elevate the quality of writing across every touchpoint, advocating for clarity, creativity, and brand-led thinking. - Explore new creative formats and cultural opportunities that push the Replit story forward. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - 6+ years of experience in brand writing or copywriting at leading agencies, technology companies, or in-house creative teams. - A portfolio that demonstrates conceptual strength and world-class copywriting across campaigns, platforms, and marketing assets. - Mastery of language, storytelling, and voice, with a proven eye for detail and craft. - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams at the intersection of marketing, product, and design. - Ability to drive work from concept to final execution in fast-paced, iterative environments. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience creating or scaling global brand voice and editorial systems. - Exposure to writing across motion, digital platforms, and experiential activations. - Strong presentation and communication skills able to inspire confidence in creative direction across stakeholders. - Interest in AI, creativity, and shaping the cultural narrative around new technologies. This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend 🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment 🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only) 🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings ☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only) Want to learn more about what we are up to? - Meet the Replit Agent https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IYiVPrxY8-Y - Replit: Make an app for that https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zd9hzngFwY - Replit Blog https://blog.replit.com/ - Amjad TED Talk https://youtu.be/k

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:7bde575d-.description: ABOUT GEN: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Corporate Counsel, Product & Commercial, you will be a key legal partner to our product, engineering, UX, marketing and sales teams, helping shape how our consumer and technology products are designed, built, marketed, and brought to market. You will provide practical, business‑oriented legal advice across the product lifecycle – from ideation and design reviews, through launch and go‑to‑market, to ongoing customer experience and lifecycle management. You will also support complex commercial transactions and strategic partnerships that help position our products effectively in the marketplace, with a strong focus on clear, balanced risk management and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. In this highly cross‑functional role, you will collaborate closely with colleagues to deliver cohesive, aligned guidance to the business. We are looking for a confident self‑starter with strong business judgment who thrives in a fast‑paced, high‑energy environment and enjoys simplifying complexity for stakeholders. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Product counseling & go‑to‑market - Serve as primary legal advisor to product, UX, engineering and marketing teams on product design, feature development, and customer experience, providing clear, pragmatic guidance that balances innovation and risk. - Advise on product marketing claims, offers, and customer journeys, including consumer protection, marketing, and customer communications considerations. - Provide guidance on data and technology issues related to our products, partnering with Privacy and Security colleagues to support compliant and trustworthy product experiences. - Help stakeholders understand legal issues, options, and trade‑offs by distilling complex concepts into concise, actionable recommendations for decision‑makers. Commercial transactions & partnerships - Draft, review, and negotiate standard and bespoke contracts for our various sales and partner channels, including distributor, reseller, technology and vendor agreements. - Support the execution of strategic partnerships and inbound license agreements that enable product capabilities and go‑to‑market strategies. - Work cross‑functionally with business teams to structure commercial deals in ways that advance business goals while appropriately managing legal and regulatory risk. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7595c82c-fef8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Developer – Trade Finance based in Germany. As a Business Developer, you will drive the origination and development of strategic relationships with Trade Finance Institutions. You will identify and prioritize prospective partners while uncovering opportunities that support broader commercial objectives. The role combines financial expertise, relationship management, business development, and technology-enabled market intelligence. You will engage directly with banks, fintechs, clearing institutions, brokerages, and other financial organizations. Modern software and AI-supported techniques will help you research markets, assess prospects, and work efficiently with complex information. jobgether-jobgether:lever:79ffda01-3a1b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Engineering Manager based in United States. This is a senior engineering and architecture leadership role responsible for the technical direction of an Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) practice. You’ll own end-to-end solution architecture across multiple identity engagements, from identity models and governance frameworks to integrations and migration strategies. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical oversight, giving you the opportunity to review and shape complex designs rather than simply manage teams. You’ll lead a distributed engineering organization, mentor technical talent, establish delivery standards, and ensure high-quality outcomes across concurrent client programs. You’ll work directly with IAM Directors, Enterprise Architects, and CISO organizations while influencing major identity and cybersecurity initiatives. The environment is fast-moving and entrepreneurial, with significant opportunities to contribute to presales, reusable engineering IP, vendor partnerships, and practice growth. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced IAM/IGA leader who wants to combine technical authority, client impact, and engineering leadership. Own end-to-end solution architecture for IGA engagements, including identity models, authoritative source strategies, account correlation, entitlement catalogs, and target governance operating models. Act as the technical design authority across a portfolio of engagements, reviewing and approving connector designs, lifecycle and provisioning workflows, RBAC/ABAC models, segregation-of-duties rules, and certification campaign architectures. Build and lead a distributed engineering bench, including staffing engineers across the US and Pune, technical mentoring, code and configuration quality reviews, and career development. Own migration strategies for legacy-to-modern IGA transformations, including coexistence planning, data migration, sequencing, and cutover execution. Design and oversee joiner-mover-leaver automation using HR authoritative sources such as Workday, SuccessFactors, and SAP HCM, including birthright access, contractor lifecycle, non-employee management, and emergency deprovisioning. Serve as a senior technical advisor to client IAM Directors, Enterprise Architects, and CISO organizations, leading architecture reviews and design authority sessions. Support business development and practice growth through solution shaping, effort estimation, technical SOW development, RFP/RFI responses, and proof-of-concept leadership. Establish delivery governance across engagements, managing technical risks, dependencies, technical debt, and go/no-go recommendations at key delivery gates. Develop and maintain reusable practice IP, including reference architectures, connectors, accelerators, estimation frameworks, and design pattern libraries. Maintain strong technical relationships with leading identity technology vendors and contribute to certification programs and strategic partner development. Drive innovation across the IGA practice by identifying opportunities to improve delivery methodologies, technical solutions, and client outcomes. Requirements 8+ years of experience in IAM/IGA , including at least 4 years leading engineering or architecture teams within a professional services, systems integration, or managed services environment. Deep hands-on experience with at least two major identity platforms, such as SailPoint IdentityIQ/Identity Security Cloud, Saviynt EIC, Okta Identity Governance, or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. Demonstrated expertise in full identity lifecycle design, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, birthright access, role-based provisioning, access requests and approvals, delegated administration, deprovisioning, and orphan-account management.
